title: Build level system with platforms, terrain, and scrolling
description: Create a tile-based level system with solid platforms, ground tiles, and gaps. Implement side-scrolling camera that follows the player. Build a level generator that creates procedurally generated levels with increasing difficulty (wider gaps, more obstacles per section). Add at least 3 distinct visual tile types (grass, stone, ice). Store level data as 2D arrays. Dependencies: Task 1, Task 2
